_comment: SFMon Fleet Mode - monitors every org listed in 'orgs' from this one container. Each name resolves to a SALESFORCE_AUTH_URL_<NAME> env var (uppercased, non-alphanumerics -> '_'): 'prod' -> SALESFORCE_AUTH_URL_PROD, 'sandbox-uat' -> SALESFORCE_AUTH_URL_SANDBOX_UAT. ORG_NAME is ignored once 'orgs' is set. See docs/CONFIGURATION.md#fleet-mode--multiple-orgs.

schedules._comment_critical: Critical functions - every 5 minutes - applies to every org unless overridden below
schedules._comment_hourly: Hourly functions - staggered throughout the hour

_comment_org_overrides: Optional: per-org schedule entries merged over 'schedules' above (explicit per-org entry wins). Any job id valid under 'schedules' is valid here too.
